entity.description:
In an early alliterative version of The Ballad of the Sons of Húrin, the elf Beleg Cúthalion recites a magical "whetting spell" over his sword. During that spell he invokes several legendary weapons, including"Ogbar's Spear."

The intriguing part is that Tolkien never explains who Ogbar was. According to scholarly references discussing the text, Ogbar's identity is completely unknown. The name appears only in connection with the spear, and there are no surviving notes that identify Ogbar as an Elf, Man, or Dwarf, nor any story describing the spear's deeds.

This type of unexplained reference is actually typical of Tolkien's world-building. He occasionally mentioned ancient heroes, places, or objects without providing their full histories, creating the impression of a much deeper legendary past behind the main stories. Ogbar appears to be one of these mysterious figures. Category:Characters
